environment.description: Kubernetes deployment in namespace 'search-services'. Ktor service exposed via ClusterIP Service on port 8080. No Istio sidecar injection (istio-injection label not set on namespace). Service is reachable from any pod in the cluster via DNS (search-svc.search-services.svc.cluster.local:8080). Frontend proxy in namespace 'web-gateway' forwards user-supplied query parameters directly to this service. No input sanitization at any layer.

config.frontend_proxy: web-gateway namespace, passes raw query params
